product.description: Monoprice™ Commercial SeriesFull‑Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount BracketFor 43" to 90" flat and curved TVs weighing up to 132 poundsThis Monoprice™ Commercial Series Full‑Motion Articulating TV Wall Mount Bracket allows you to adjust your TV for the most comfortable viewing angle, no matter where you choose to sit. Constructed of cold‑rolled steel, it can swivel up to 60° side‑to‑side, tilts from +3° ~ ‑15°, rotates ±5°, and can extend from 3.0" to 16.9" from the wall. It is designed for curved or flat screen TVs from 43" ~ 90" weighing up to 132 pounds, with VESA® mounting patterns from 300x200 to 800x400.VESA® compatible from 300x200 to 800x400Designed for 43" to 90" displaysSwivels ±60 degreesTilts +3 ~ ‑15 degreesRotates ±5 degrees132 pounds weight capacityExtends from 3.0" to 16.9" from the wallDesigned to work with both flat and curved displaysBuilt‑in cable management FULL‑MOTION ARTICULATING WALL MOUNTMonoprice™ full‑motion wall mounts offer the ultimate in comfort and flexibility. The articulated swing arm allows you to move the TV towards or away from the wall, tilt it up or down, and angle it from side‑to‑side. The articulating plate holding the TV also allows you to rotate the TV to ensure it is level. "IS THIS MOUNT COMPATIBLE WITH MY TV?"Check your TV's manual for its VESA® mounting pattern or measure the horizontal and vertical distances between the mounting holes (in mm).This mount supports VESA patterns between 300x200 and 800x400.This mount supports TVs weighing up to 132 pounds.The screen size range is only a suggested approximation. Your TV is compatible as long as its VESA mounting pattern is between 300x200 and 800x400 and it weighs no more than 132 pounds. DESIGNED FOR FLAT AND CURVED DISPLAYSThis mount is designed for 43" ~ 90" flat and curved displays. RECOMMENDED TOOLSThe following tools are highly recommended for making the installation of your wall mount as safe and straightforward as possible.
